name: Cut Paper
description: Torn-edge paper shapes with soft drop shadows, paper grain and crayon in the fills, patterns (stripes, dots, gingham, wood grain), full-bleed colour worlds, and characters with simple faces. Collage-style animation: playful, warm, busy with small life.
style: Cut-paper collage: every shape is torn paper with a wobbly edge, soft shadow and grain; one dominant wall colour per scene, pops for arrivals, hand-lettered text on paper tags, the spark's ray count telling time.
